I am going through a lot right now, but I feel the need to say this during these unprecedented times: A lot of Iranians supported the strikes because they believed it will help them topple the regime. I myself reluctantly supported it and went against everything I believe in. I can’t in good conscience support this shit show. This is a war on Iran and the Iranian people and it’s not about changing the regime. I apologize to the Iranian people because I knew better

Iranian human rights lawyer and activist Nasrin Sotoudeh was arrested last night, according to an Instagram post by her daughter.

Her daughter said she had heard from relatives that Sotoudeh and her husband’s electronic devices had also been confiscated.
